media.title: On a volé un homme (1934) — sheet-music collection cover
media.description: Sheet-music/film cover for On a volé un homme (1934), documenting the film and its music by Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann. Exact visual provenance is the official Walter Jurmann cover gallery image 28wj-cover-On-a_vole_un_homme1934.jpg.
media.altText: Vintage sheet-music collection cover for “On a volé un homme,” advertising “Ni mal, ni bien” and “Un regard de femme.”
